pages.title: Optional Discoveries
pages.text: The following page describes effects tied to Reality Rifts and Harmonium. Continue when you are ready for those late-game systems.

pages.title: Zero, Power & Harmonium
pages.text: Zero distorts chat and adds digital effects. Power muffles sound and adds a dark overlay. Harmonium applies a color effect tied to the item. Read $(l:psychedelicraft:discoveries/rifts)Reality Rifts$(/l) or $(l:psychedelicraft:discoveries/harmonium)Harmonium$(/l) for the sources.
